verdict.rationale: The docs walk the full API flow: creating a collection, adding documents, then searching, filtering and faceting (typesense-docs-8). The complete API surface ships in the open-source server (typesense-docs-61), a community user confirms the REST interface (typesense-comm-3), and an official CLI is documented (typesense-probe-4). For agents, Typesense Cloud's official MCP server lets an agent build collections, index data and tune search from the conversation (typesense-docs-43, typesense-docs-52), backed by an 'AI Agents' guide (typesense-docs-17) and llms.txt (typesense-probe-1). Missing for 10: the MCP server appears to be Cloud-only rather than available for self-hosted servers, no independent hands-on report of an agent running the end-to-end flow, and no published OpenAPI spec was found (typesense-probe-3).
